remarks: Experience Elevated Waterfront Living at OPUS at Harbor Point Welcome to OPUS at Harbor Point, the newest luxury waterfront residence designed for those who appreciate refinement and sophistication. Nestled beside the picturesque Long Island Sound, OPUS is a boutique-style residential building where every space is artfully crafted with rich materials, textures, and tones that whisper timeless opulence. At OPUS, first-class service is at the core of every amenity. From in-house spa rooms and a highly trained concierge to a state-of-the-art gym and a private putting green, each detail is designed to create a seamless, effortless lifestyle. Like a beautifully composed melody, OPUS offers a harmonious blend of luxury, comfort, and tranquility, allowing you to move through your day with ease and elegance.
